blocker_findings.finding: RA 9266 special-vs-temporary permit distinction remains unverified against requested RA-9266 IRR PDF and PRBoA temporary-permits resolution PDF.

PRC STP form identifies Special Temporary Permit categories. STP1 covers foreign professionals practicing under reciprocity/international agreements and explicitly lists Architecture; STP2 covers consultants in foreign-funded/joint venture/foreign-assisted projects; STP3 covers employees of Philippine/foreign private firms/institutions pursuant to law.

Fee-flow/documentation claims mixing Section 27 and Section 38 could not be validated in the target article/questions because those local records were not found. Profession-specific PRC STP requirements mention architecture professional liability/malpractice insurance or equivalent bond, but do not verify RA 9266 Sections 27/38 fee-flow claims.
